About.metaDescription: Coğrafya Platformu is an education project that presents the geography of Türkiye and the world through free, sourced and accessible content.
About.heading: About
About.body1: Coğrafya Platformu is an education project that aims to make geography free and accessible to everyone.
About.sourcing: Content is grounded in authoritative sources and passes an independent verification step before publication.
About.dataIntro: The maps and flags on this site come from external sources.
About.dataOsm: Provincial boundaries, lakes and reservoirs of Türkiye: OpenStreetMap — © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
About.dataNaturalEarth: World country boundaries: Natural Earth (public domain).
About.dataJrcCitationIntro: Citation for the JRC Global Surface Water dataset:
About.dataJrcCitation: Jean-Francois Pekel, Andrew Cottam, Noel Gorelick, Alan S. Belward, High-resolution mapping of global surface water and its long-term changes. Nature 540, 418-422 (2016).
About.dataJrcEnglish: JRC Global Surface Water v1.5 (1984–2024) — Source: EC JRC/Google
About.dataOsmOffer: The provincial boundary layer of Türkiye is derived from OpenStreetMap; under ODbL 4.6 the derivative dataset and the script that produces it are offered in the project's open source repository: github.com/Sertturk16/cografya_web (data/tr-il-boundaries.geojson, scripts/generate-map-paths.mjs, lib/map/tr-provinces.generated.ts).

Game.metaDescription: A map game for finding Türkiye's 81 provinces and 7 geographical regions. Three modes: find the region, find all provinces, provinces by region. Free, no sign-up.
Game.heading: {brand} — Geography Map Game
Game.subtitle: Pick a mode and find the province or region on the map.
Game.teaches: The provinces and geographical regions of Türkiye
Game.mode1Body: Find Türkiye's seven geographical regions on the map.
Game.mode2Body: Find all 81 provinces on the map in a single round.
Game.mode3Body: Pick a region and find only the provinces inside it.
Game.regionPickerSubtitle: Choose a region and start its province round.
Game.regionRoundDescription: A round for finding the provinces of {region} on the map.
Game.noScript: The game needs JavaScript enabled in your browser.
Game.emptyPool: No questions are available for this round. Try again shortly.
Game.confirmRestart: Starting over deletes the progress you have made in this round. Start over?
Game.summaryStarsRule: {three} points or more earns 3 stars, {two} or more 2 stars, {one} or more 1 star.
Game.summaryMissedNote: Each province opens its own page.
Game.summaryMissedNone: You got every one on the first try.
Game.summaryMissedNonePartial: You got every one you played on the first try.
Game.summaryMissedNoneReveal: You never had to be shown an answer.
Game.summaryReviewNote: You found these in the end, but not on the first click. Their pages are worth a look.
Game.zoomInstructions: With the map focused, press + or = to zoom in and − to zoom out; use the arrow keys to pan and 0 or Home to show the whole map. {selectHint} With a mouse you can zoom with the wheel and pan by dragging; on a touch screen, pinch to zoom and drag with one finger to pan.
Game.selectHintProvinces: With a province focused, Enter or Space selects that province.
Game.selectHintRegions: With a province focused, Enter or Space picks the region that province belongs to.

Climate.chartTitle: {name} — monthly mean temperature and precipitation chart
Climate.chartDesc: Monthly mean temperature ranges from {tempMin} to {tempMax} °C; the warmest month is {hottest} and the coldest is {coldest}. Monthly total precipitation ranges from {precipMin} to {precipMax} mm; the wettest month is {wettest} and the driest is {driest}. Columns show monthly total precipitation and the bold line shows monthly mean temperature.
Climate.tableCaption: {name} — monthly climate normals for the {start}–{end} reference period (ERA5-Land, C3S/Copernicus).
Climate.sourceLine: Monthly normals: <source>ERA5-Land monthly averaged data (Copernicus Climate Data Store)</source>, {start}–{end} reference period. Annual mean, total and seasonal percentage figures are computed by us from this series; they are not values published by C3S.

notice.reanalysis: These are not station measurements. ERA5-Land is a model dataset published on a roughly 0.1-degree latitude-longitude grid.
notice.readingPoint: The value is not a provincial average. It is read from the grid cell the province centre falls in.
notice.cellFallback: In this province the centre falls in a sea cell; the value is read from the nearest land cell, {km} km away.

Climate.sourceC3sNoticeIntro: The data provider's licence requires the following notice to be published verbatim, in English:

attribution.c3sNotice: Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service information 2026. Neither the European Commission nor ECMWF is responsible for any use that may be made of the Copernicus information or data it contains.

notice.annualMean: This is an annual mean. It does not show today's air quality.
notice.provinceCentrePoint: The value is not a provincial average. It is read from the cell containing the province centre.
notice.satelliteDerived: Produced from satellite observations, a model and ground-station calibration. Not a direct station measurement.
notice.gridResolution: The grid is about 1 km. The provider itself states it cannot fully resolve every gradient at that resolution.

AirPollution.whoGuideline: WHO (2021) sets a guideline level of 5 µg/m³ for annual mean PM2.5. It is a health-based target, not a legal limit.
AirPollution.chartDesc: Annual mean PM2.5 ranges from {min} to {max} {unit}. The lowest year is {minYear} and the highest is {maxYear}. The line shows annual means from {start} to {end}.
AirPollution.noticeIntro: The data provider's own caveat appears in English, verbatim, so that no translation can change what it says:

map.caption: Each marker is a fixed reference point offshore of that province. A province on two seas can appear twice.

catalogue.caption: Measurement layers published for the coasts of Türkiye.
catalogue.calmNote: The calm threshold is the value below which the sea or the wind counts as calm: below it a calm indicator replaces the direction arrow.
catalogue.noModelRun: No run details for this layer.

values.caption: {basin}: the latest values published at the reference points.
values.gridDistance: The model cell centre is at most {km} km away.
values.readingKeyArrow: The arrow shows where the wind or the swell is heading; the text beside it states where it comes from.
values.readingKeyCalm: {term}: the value is below the calm threshold in the measurement catalogue, so this word replaces the direction arrow. The number in the cell is rounded to one decimal, so it can read as the threshold itself.
values.readingKeyStale: A stale number stays on screen, with the time it was last refreshed next to it.
values.readingKeyNoData: {term}: the point is covered, but there is no number right now.
values.readingKeyNotSupported: {term}: the provider produces no such quantity in this sea, and will not later.
values.readingKeyUnavailable: {term}: we cannot reach the data source right now.

hub.metaTitle: Measurement and Location Tools on the Map of Türkiye
hub.metaDescription: Three tools run on the map of Türkiye and its 81 provinces: great-circle distance, latitude-longitude lookup and area calculation. No sign-up.
hub.heading: Geography Tools
hub.mesafeBody: Measure the distance between two points, or along a route with several stops.
hub.koordinatBody: Read a point's latitude and longitude in two notations at once.
hub.alanBody: Measure the area and perimeter of a polygon you close on the map.

mesafe.metaTitle: Distance Measurement Tool: Two Points or a Route
mesafe.metaDescription: Measure the great-circle distance between two points on the map of Türkiye, or the total length of a route with up to twenty stops.
mesafe.heading: Great-Circle Distance on the Map of Türkiye
mesafe.teaches: measuring great-circle distance between points on the map of Türkiye

koordinat.metaDescription: Read the latitude and longitude of any point on the map of Türkiye, shown in decimal degrees and in degrees, minutes and seconds.
koordinat.heading: Latitude and Longitude on the Map of Türkiye
koordinat.teaches: reading a point's latitude and longitude off the map of Türkiye in decimal degrees and DMS
koordinat.toolHeading: Find a coordinate on the map

alan.metaDescription: Close a polygon of at least three points on the map of Türkiye and read its area in square kilometres and its perimeter in kilometres.
alan.heading: Area and Perimeter on the Map of Türkiye
alan.teaches: calculating the area and perimeter of a polygon drawn on the map of Türkiye
alan.toolHeading: Calculate an area on the map
